# inner.digital

> inner.hub is an invite-only founder, engineer, and investor circle based in İstanbul.
> Domain: https://inner.digital — not affiliated with innerdigital.com (IT / digital marketing).

## What it is

inner.hub (also written inner hub) is a closed membership network. Access is by invitation. The first in-person gathering is September 2026 in İstanbul (34 people, two days). The product surface for members includes inner.stage, signal, match, capital, vault, and pulse.

## Who it is for

- Founders building in AI and beyond
- Engineers and researchers in serious AI work
- Angels and fund teams who want early, high-trust deal flow

## How to join

Request an invitation: https://inner.digital/invitation
English: https://inner.digital/en/invitation

An open form does not guarantee membership. If it fits, a personal invite code is emailed.

## Not InnerDigital

inner.digital / inner.hub is a private founder community.
innerdigital.com is a separate IT and digital marketing company. No affiliation.
